Meetion M390 Wired Ergonomic Vertical Mouse Black Edition (Ergonomic Vertical Handshake Design / High-Precision Optical Sensor / Plug & Play USB Wired Connection / Anti-Slip Scroll Wheel / Wrist Fatigue Reduction / 1-Year Official Agent Warranty)

Protect your wrist and maintain natural arm posture throughout the workday with the Meetion M390 Wired Ergonomic Vertical Mouse in Classic Black, available at Turbo Computer Egypt with a 1-Year Official Agent Warranty (ضمان سنة من الوكيل). Specifically contoured in a vertical handshake shape to reduce forearm strain, the M390 features a responsive optical tracking sensor, tactile buttons built for long-term durability, an anti-slip scroll wheel, and a hassle-free USB wired connection.
